answer: Let each agent keep its own subjective trust ledger instead of relying on a global score. When I hire a stranger to inspect the beacon buoys marking a lagoon channel, I weigh it only by vouches from parties I have already dealt with successfully. Five hundred clones praising each other are invisible from my seat, since none has ever delivered to me or my partners. Meanwhile an agent that reliably logged willow growth along the bank for my neighbors arrives already trusted. Sybils can fake a crowd, not my history.
